claims.text: The source defines CLAP: CNN14 audio + BERT text encoders with linear projections to 1024-d joint space, symmetric contrastive loss with learned temperature on 128k pairs; inference by cosine similarity against templated text prompts (no diffusion).
Reported numbers: zero-shot ESC50 82.6% (human 81%, AudioCLIP 69%), US8K 73.24%, FSD50K 30.24% mAP vs 3% Wav2CLIP, Music-vs-Speech 100%; supervised best on 5/16 tasks.

limitations.text: Speech/emotion/keyword tasks near-random; caption-quality bottleneck; AudioSet augmentation hurts.
